messages.content: Find me a documentary about global warming.

function.name: retrieve_scientific_paper
function.description: Fetches the details of scientific research paper based on its topic. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

year.description: Year of publishing of the research paper. If not specified, fetches the most recent paper

author.description: Author of the research paper. If not specified, fetches the paper with most citations

message.content:
Here’s a highly regarded documentary that tackles the issue of global warming:

| Title | Year | Director | Synopsis |
|-------|------|----------|----------|
| **An Inconvenient Truth** | 2006 | Davis Guggenheim | Former U.S. Vice President Al Gore presents a compelling case for climate change, using data and personal anecdotes to illustrate the science behind global warming and its potential impacts. |
| **An Inconvenient Sequel: Truth to Power** | 2017 | Davis Guggenheim | A follow‑up to the original film, this sequel examines how the world has responded to climate change over the decade since the first release, highlighting new challenges and opportunities for action. |
| **Before the Flood** | 2015 | Fisher Stevens | Leonardo DiCaprio explores the causes and consequences of climate change, traveling around the globe to meet scientists, activists, and policymakers. |

All three films are widely available on streaming platforms such as Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, or Hulu. They provide a mix of scientific explanation, visual evidence, and calls to action that make them accessible to a broad audience.
